idea-plugin.name: Tool Finder
idea-plugin.description: Search and open every available IDE tool window from a single keyboard-driven popup. Open the popup with <kbd>Ctrl+Shift+T</kbd> (<kbd>Cmd+Shift+T</kbd> on macOS), type to filter the list, and use <kbd>Up</kbd>, <kbd>Down</kbd>, and <kbd>Enter</kbd> to activate a tool window.

action.description: Search and open IDE tool windows
